sources.summary: Discover how to implement a streaming 3D reconstruction pipeline using LingBot-Map. From GPU-aware configuration and preprocessing to GCTStream model inference and point cloud generation, this guide walks you through the steps to convert image or video sequences into consistent 3D scenes with exportable PLY and NPZ artifacts. The post LingBot-Map Tutorial: GPU-Aware Inference and Point Cloud Export appeared first on MarkTechPost .
